packages.name: SSC-Tracker
packages.shortDescription: Aircraft tracking and task monitoring for glider pilots
packages.description: SSC-Tracker is the companion app for the Sim Soaring Club. It provides real-time aircraft tracking on a map, terrain and wind data display, and task monitoring for soaring activities in Microsoft Flight Simulator. Connect with other SSC pilots during weekly group flights and competitions.

packages.name: NB21 Logger
packages.shortDescription: Sim gliding data logger for MSFS.
packages.description: Track, log, and analyze your flights in Microsoft Flight Simulator with NB21 Logger. This application creates IGC-format tracklogs compatible with glider flights or any aircraft, featuring real-world UTC time recording and advanced data capabilities.

packages.name: SSC Weather
packages.shortDescription: SSC Soaring Weather Presets for MSFS 2024
packages.description: This add-on includes 122 presets optimized to provide realistic lift conditions for thermal and ridge soaring around the world.

packages.name: ASK21
packages.description: The ASK 21 is a popular German two-seater glider, first built in 1979. It is primarily used for beginner instruction and aerobatics training, as well as for transitioning pilots from older wooden gliders like the K 8 to modern single-seat composite gliders. Capable of withstanding g-loads of +6.5 and -4G, it has a maximum speed of 280 km/h.

packages.name: SSC Towplane Robin
packages.description: This mod enhances the stock Robin DR400 aircraft in MSFS 2024, converting it into a functional towplane ideal for launching gliders. It has been tested for efficient aerotows, including the fully ballasted JS3-18 glider from a 1600-foot runway with no wind. This modification addresses the limitations of existing towplanes in the simulator, providing a more reliable launch mechanism for gliding enthusiasts7
